Maya is a parent of Noah. Noah is a parent of Lina. Maya is also a parent of Owen. Owen is a parent of Sara. Cross-domain check: a survey team starts work at 12:00 and works for 2 hour(s) without a break.

A parent is one generation above a child. A grandparent is two parent-links above. People who share a parent are siblings under this simplified model. For the cross-domain check, finishing time = starting time + duration.
What family relation between Noah and Owen follows from the stated links? Cross-domain check: at what time does the team finish?
1. Maya is parent of both Noah and Owen. 2. Sharing a parent satisfies the simplified sibling rule. Cross-domain check: 12+2=14, so the team finishes at 14:00.
Noah and Owen are siblings. Cross-domain answer: 14:00.

Maya is a parent of Noah. Noah is a parent of Lina. Maya is also a parent of Owen. Owen is a parent of Sara. Cross-domain check: researchers collected 11 reports, but 4 are exact duplicate copies that add no new independent information. Mixed-domain verification: a regional archive has 95 map sheets and receives 6 additional sheets during the exercise.

A parent is one generation above a child. A grandparent is two parent-links above. People who share a parent are siblings under this simplified model. For the cross-domain check, independent reports = total reports − duplicate copies. For this verification, the final number of sheets equals starting sheets plus received sheets.

What family relation between Lina and Sara follows from the stated links? Cross-domain check: how many non-duplicate reports remain? Mixed-domain verification: how many sheets are available after the delivery?

1. Noah and Owen are siblings because they share parent Maya. 2. Lina is child of Noah; Sara is child of Owen. 3. Children of siblings are cousins in this model. Cross-domain check: 11−4=7 independent reports remain. Mixed-domain verification: 95+6=101.
Lina and Sara are cousins under the implied family tree. Cross-domain answer: 7 independent reports. Mixed-domain answer: 101 map sheets.
